Sam: quick check — from the postmortem: we have 4 action items that cross teams. can owners confirm who is doing what and a hard due date? 
Priya: I own: 'kafka consumer retry logic' (Inc901-A). targeting 2025-09-18 EOD. will put a short RFC in the doc.
Diego: I'll take 'deploy automation rollback script' (Inc901-B) but blocked on the db migration window. pinging @Morgan for the migration ETA.
Morgan: I can reserve a 2hr window on 2025-09-17 16:00-18:00 PT. Diego, is that enough?
Diego: yes that works for the migration — thanks. I'll scope the rollback script to be no-op until we flip the feature flag.
Ava: QA will need a test plan for the rollback and the consumer changes. can we get test vectors by 2025-09-16? otherwise we won't finish validation.
Sam: noted. new tentative timeline: Priya 09/18, Diego 09/17-09/18 (migration+rollout), QA (Ava) to validate by 09/19. 
oncall-bot: Incident Inc901 status changed to 'monitoring' — all action items in tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC901
Priya: added a short summary and owner tags in the postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.com/pm/inc901/rca. please update if you change dates.
Diego: quick heads-up — PR #4821 is open for the rollback script. @Sam can you do a quick review? small shell + python change.
Sam: will review PR #4821 today, aiming before 15:00 PT.
Ava: I'll start QA vectors today, will drop results in the doc and in this thread by 2025-09-16 18:00 PT.
Sam: thanks all. can each owner add a calendar invite to the RFC timeline and mark the doc with 'owner confirmed' so I can close the postmortem checklist? I'll follow up tomorrow for any late blockers. :thumbsup:
